clue.text: Rugby forward is bear a man!

definitions.note: a cartoon bear who dresses and behaves like a little man

parts.note: RU is the standard abbreviation for Rugby Union
forward in the sense of cheeky or impudent means pert

explanation.surface: An excited remark that a burly rugby forward is a bear of a man.
explanation.walkthrough: Rupert Bear is a long-running British children's comic-strip character, a bear in checked trousers and scarf who lives like a human boy; Rupert is also a man's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous British comic-strip bear carries this name, which is also an ordinary male first name.

clue.text: Drop in this month by island lake

parts.note: inst., short for instant, is old business-letter shorthand for this month
I is a common abbreviation for island on maps
L is a common abbreviation for lake on maps

explanation.surface: Someone plans to drop in on an island lake some time this month.
explanation.definitionFit: To instil originally meant to introduce liquid drop by drop, hence to put in gradually.

clue.text: Takes a grip and is likely to be stung

definitions.meaning: figuratively, tackles a difficulty boldly and firmly
literally, someone clutching a stinging weed will probably get stung

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to deal firmly with a problem; taken literally, seizing a stinging plant risks a sting.

clue.text: Revolutionary by-product?

parts.note: read literally, something thrown off by a rotating motion; in everyday use a secondary product or benefit

explanation.definitionFit: A secondary product developed from something else; literally, what flies off when something whirls round.

clue.text: Thunder from a clear sky-how surprising

definitions.meaning: literally, lightning striking out of a cloudless heaven

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a sudden shock, from the image of lightning striking without any storm clouds.

clue.text: Unusually large mouse Ron freed

indicators.note: freed suggests the letters are let loose from their order and set down anew

explanation.surface: An unusually large mouse has been released by someone called Ron.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freed' tells you to rearrange MOUSE and RON.
explanation.definitionFit: Enormous is a straightforward synonym for huge or vast.

clue.text: Sit astride, right up in the seat

indicators.note: in tells you the reversed letters sit inside the seat word

parts.note: a saddle is the seat for a rider

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters climb, so they are read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Instructions to sit on a horse astride, right up in the saddle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns RT into TR, and 'in' puts it inside SADDLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To straddle is to sit or stand with a leg on each side of something.

clue.text: He didn't quite win the hill climb

definitions.text: He didn't quite win the hill climb

parts.words: He didn't quite win the hill climb
parts.note: the person who came second in a race; also, playfully, one who runs up a slope

explanation.definitionFit: The competitor finishing second, just short of victory; the hill climb invites the literal reading of someone running uphill.

clue.text: Elaborately adorned or neat design

indicators.note: design suggests the letters are arranged to a new pattern

explanation.surface: Contrasting something elaborately decorated with a neat, plain design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'design' tells you to rearrange OR and NEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornate describes something with lots of decoration, the opposite of plain.

clue.text: State shortly that one is out of sorts

definitions.meaning: .... is the traditional abbreviation of the US state of Illinois

explanation.definitionFit: The US state Illinois is abbreviated Ill.; the plain word also means unwell or poorly.

clue.text: To abandon aeroplane is not out former

parts.note: a jet is a jet-propelled aeroplane

indicators.note: out signals that the words is not are thrown into disorder and formed afresh

explanation.surface: A muddled statement about abandoning an aeroplane and a former player not being out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out former' tells you to rearrange IS NOT into TISON, after JET. The surface plays on the cricket phrase 'not out', for a batsman still at the crease.
explanation.definitionFit: To jettison is to throw overboard or discard, as cargo dumped from a ship or aircraft.

clue.text: A burnt twisted headdress

indicators.note: twisted signals that the letters of A burnt are wrenched into a new order

explanation.surface: A burnt and twisted headdress, perhaps after an accident.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted' tells you to rearrange A and BURNT.
explanation.definitionFit: A turban is a long cloth wound round the head, worn as a headdress.

clue.text: Speechless when the script has been mislaid

definitions.meaning: unable to think what to say

definitions.text: when the script has been mislaid
definitions.meaning: literally, an actor who has lost the text of their lines

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means unable to find anything to say; literally, someone whose written lines have gone missing.

clue.text: Breezy tune?

parts.note: the word means both a melody and a light wind or the atmosphere, so a breezy tune is one word

explanation.definitionFit: The word is a musical term for a melody and also means a breeze or the atmosphere.

clue.text: A prize is degenerating

definitions.note: the answer is a noun or verb naming wasting away, here read as the process of degenerating

parts.note: a trophy is a prize such as a cup

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a prize is losing its value.
explanation.definitionFit: Atrophy is the wasting away of a body part or faculty through disuse, a gradual decline.

clue.text: Complete although uneven

parts.note: tho' is an informal shortening of though, i.e. although
a rough surface is uneven

explanation.surface: A remark that something is complete although uneven in quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorough as in a thorough mess means complete or utter.

clue.text: Eavesdrop this way, so to speak

indicators.note: so to speak signals that the phrase for this way is to be pronounced, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: come over here is how you call someone this way

explanation.surface: Advice on how to eavesdrop: do it this way, as it were.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so to speak' tells you that 'over here' sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To overhear is to catch a conversation one was not meant to hear, as an eavesdropper does.

clue.text: In the hut mother's shattered

indicators.note: In says the mother's letters go inside the word for hut

parts.note: a shed is a hut
ma is mother, and the 's gives MAS

explanation.surface: Mother is exhausted, out in the garden hut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' puts MAS inside SHED. 'shattered' looks like 'exhausted' but here means broken to pieces (or, in British slang, very drunk).
explanation.definitionFit: Smashed means broken into fragments, just as shattered does.

clue.text: Joint cheerleader

definitions.meaning: the ball-and-socket joint at the top of the leg
the word that leads a cheer

explanation.definitionFit: It is the joint between thigh and pelvis, and the word that leads off a cheer of hooray.

clue.text: Weed some people burn pleasure

parts.note: a plant, slangily a weed, that smokers set alight for enjoyment

explanation.definitionFit: Smokers burn this leaf for enjoyment, and it is jokingly called the weed.

clue.text: Be frank and enter the golf tour

definitions.meaning: stop concealing things and speak openly
literally, take part in a big golf championship known as the Open

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to stop hiding; literally, to join the field of the Open golf championship.

clue.text: Ducks drinking wine in Portugal

definitions.note: the clue gives a location rather than a name: a place found in Portugal

indicators.note: drinking means the ducks take the wine into themselves, enclosing it

parts.note: a duck is a score of nought in cricket, so two ducks give two Os
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: Ducks sipping port while in Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: Oporto, also called Porto, is Portugal's second city, home of the port-wine trade.

clue.text: Many left aroused and went away

indicators.note: left means the many letter has departed from the word for aroused

parts.note: aroused means excited
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many

explanation.surface: Many people left, stirred up, and went off.
explanation.definitionFit: Exited means departed or went out.

clue.text: Wear for formal occasions that includes work

indicators.note: includes means the word that holds the work abbreviation inside it

parts.note: OP is short for opus, Latin for a work

explanation.surface: Describing formal attire that comes with a job.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall silk hat worn at weddings, races and other formal events.

clue.text: Rambo is transformed with a heavenly food

indicators.note: transformed means the letters of Rambo is take on a new shape

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: The action hero Rambo is changed by eating heavenly food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transformed' rearranges RAMBO IS into AMBROSI, then A is added.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth ambrosia was the food of the gods, conferring immortality.

clue.text: Twitch the odd letters

indicators.note: the odd letters means the first, third and fifth letters of the word Twitch

explanation.surface: An instruction to take the odd letters of a word.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking letters 1, 3 and 5 of TWITCH gives T, I, C; the result itself means a twitch.
explanation.definitionFit: A tic is an involuntary spasm or twitch of a muscle.

clue.text: Torn skin from bullied GI Alan

indicators.note: bullied suggests the letters are pushed around into a new order

explanation.surface: A soldier called Alan was bullied and ended up with torn skin.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnail is a hangnail, a torn strip of skin beside a fingernail.

clue.text: Messenger accepts model as attendant

indicators.note: accepts means the messenger word takes the letter in

parts.note: a courier is a messenger
the Model T was Ford's famous car, so model gives T

explanation.surface: A messenger takes on a model as an assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: A courtier is an attendant at a royal court.
